newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria urges restraint after U.S. attack on Iraq.
newsitem.headline: Algeria urges restraint after U.S. attack on Iraq.

text.p: Algeria on Tuesday urged "utmost restraint" following the United States' missile attack on Iraq, saying the use of force gravely affected the stability of the Middle East.

"Algeria disapproves of undue use of force carried out in this way which prolongs the painful ordeal suffered by this brotherly country and increases seriously the instability of the region," Algeria's Foreign Ministry spokesman said.

Algeria followed with "deep conern" the developments of the situation in Iraq, "namely the foreign military interventions of which Iraq is the victim," said the spokesman in a statement carried by the official Algerian news agency APS.

The U.S. military on Tuesday launched cruise missiles at air defence targets in southern Iraq in retaliation for Iraqi military attacks against Kurdish groups in the country's north, the Pentagon said.
